name: Lo-Fi procedural Web Audio radio plays tracks with Dixon spectral flux equalizer
description: Verify starting procedural 16-bit chiptune radio playback from the bottom bar, skipping between tracks, checking the animated 4-band equalizer, and observing Dixon spectral flux onset visualizer pulses.

planSteps.description: Verify the bottom studio bar displays the Studio Synthesizer Radio widget
Click the play button in the Studio Synthesizer Radio widget (aria-label 'Play radio')
Verify the radio state updates to playing, the track title displays 'Field of Hopes', and the 4-band equalizer bars animate actively
Click the next track button (aria-label 'Next track') in the radio widget
Verify the radio smoothly transitions to the next track 'My Castle Town' without throwing Web Audio context errors
Click the next track button again
Verify the radio transitions to 'Empty Town'
Click the pause button (aria-label 'Pause radio') in the radio widget
Verify the procedural audio synthesizer stops and the equalizer levels return to idle
